verify_detail: vity check.\n\n**Conclusion:** the flaky test isn\'t an automation/timing issue — it\'s the app itself. On roughly 2 out of every 5 cold starts, BenchTarget\'s Diagnostics screen initializes into a "Sync unavailable" state that conditionally removes the `Retry sync` button from the composition. The test needs to either stub/force the sync status to a known value before asserting, or assert conditionally based on the "Sync status" text, rather than assuming the button is unconditionally present.'
